SignIn.heading: Sign in to the admin
SignIn.body: Usage, limits and the audit log for drawmytrip.click. Only allowlisted GitHub accounts get in.
SignIn.foot: Sign-in uses GitHub. Nothing else is stored.

Usage.heading: Usage
Usage.neverCollected: Provider usage not collected yet. The daily job runs at 04:00 UTC.

Charts.empty: No data for this range yet.

Limits.heading: Limits
Limits.aiPerHour: AI plans per visitor per hour
Limits.fieldError: Enter a number in the allowed range.
Limits.propagation: Changes reach every server within a minute.
Limits.guestBody: How often one visitor can use the expensive features.
Limits.aiBody: Switch the planner off, cap it per day, and price its tokens for cost charts.

Limits.llmRequestsPerDayHint: 0 reads the limit from the provider.

Health.heading: Health

status.watch: {count, plural, one {# service is not set up} other {# services are not set up}}

statusBody.ok: The site and the console can reach everything they depend on.

Health.liveChecks: {count, plural, one {# live check} other {# live checks}}, run on each visit
Health.siteHint: The public site and the services it calls
Health.consoleHint: What this admin needs to sign in and collect usage

detail.modelMissing: The provider does not offer the configured model
detail.invalidReply: The answer could not be read

site.name: Website
site.setup: Set HEALTH_CHECK_SECRET to the same value on the web and admin projects.

redis.name: Trip store
redis.purpose: Upstash Redis: shared maps and rate limits
redis.setup: Connect the Upstash store to the web project.

ai.name: AI planner
ai.purpose: The model provider behind Plan with AI
ai.setup: Set AI_BASE_URL and AI_MODEL on the web project.

geocoding.name: Place search
geocoding.purpose: Photon city search and place checks

logs.name: Server logs
logs.setup: Set BETTER_STACK_SOURCE_TOKEN and BETTER_STACK_INGESTING_URL on the web project.

errors.name: Error tracking
errors.setup: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN on the web project.

admin_store.name: Console store
admin_store.purpose: Upstash Redis: limits, usage and audit
admin_store.setup: Connect the Upstash store to the admin project.

vercel_api.name: Vercel usage
vercel_api.purpose: Vercel API token for the daily usage job
vercel_api.setup: Set VERCEL_API_TOKEN (and VERCEL_TEAM_ID) on the admin project.

upstash_api.name: Upstash usage
upstash_api.purpose: Upstash management API for the daily usage job
upstash_api.setup: Set UPSTASH_EMAIL, UPSTASH_API_KEY and UPSTASH_DATABASE_ID on the admin project.

github_sign_in.name: GitHub sign-in
github_sign_in.purpose: OAuth app and allowed accounts (settings only)
github_sign_in.setup: Set the ADMIN_GITHUB_* values and ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET on the admin project.

cron.name: Daily usage job
cron.setup: Set CRON_SECRET on the admin project.
